1Wind and heel back in the top leftWind angle and strength on a dial with the boat at the centre, plus heel with red limits. Zoom moves to pinch and the mouse wheel; game speed stays as one small button.
2A race strip and speed against targetClock · arrow to the next target with its distance · place. Below it, speed with a bar that fills toward target (the white tick is 100%), so you see "24%" instead of working it out. Decimal commas and «м».
3The target labelled where it isThe start line, or the next mark, gets a tag on the water. When it's off screen, the tag sits on the screen edge and points at it.
4One camera button and a readable mapA single button that cycles Drone → Top → Helm instead of three tabs. The map is bigger, rotated so the wind is at the top, shows laylines and highlights the current target.
5A clearer rudder arcDarker track and a centre mark, so you can tell at a glance how much helm you have on.
6Trim advice on the sheetThe target band is bright green and the knob turns amber when it's outside it, with a "Трави ↓" tag pointing at the knob. The trim chip at the top goes away.
7Pills that fit the wordsIcon + label pills, so «Фордевинд» fits. The main action is bigger; a button that has just appeared (Генакер) glows until you use it.
